The documented three-cylinder Lander tank rack is a different assembly from this portable-case adaptation.
Walter's embryo-disposal scene is identified; the exact empty waste vessel has not been isolated visually.
No complete personal tether assembly matched to evaprep/sailaccess is verified. The exterior sail winch is a different machine.

notes: A profile is a costume/appearance key, not a unique actor identity. The 23 inventory profiles plus Oram-field and Karine-medical make 25 static human PNGs, not 25 distinct people.
Eight walk frames form one state binding and one cycle; they do not add eight profiles or eight distinct movement types.

All four player costume keys have complete ordinary unarmed walking cycles in their 54 permitted room scopes. The three crawl-only rooms remain excluded; no run, armed or special-action coverage is inferred.
Room counts come from the compiled cycle scopes and actual appearance selector. A cycle for a profile does not imply that every room using that profile permits ordinary walking.

All 126 prop families and 630 instances are enumerated. The count without a PNG includes preserved mechanisms, environments, generic assets and gameplay adaptations; it is not a claim that every one requires a new film-exact PNG.
Related drawings and heavy EVA/closed-pod variants are catalogued separately from a proven match to a particular scene instance.
Catalogue table E1027 and Bugatti throne cannot be counted as generic DLC chair/table coverage. Biological embryo art is not automatically a specimen or embryo-tray replacement.
No new sprite generation, branch movement, central manifest write or integration-code change was performed by this audit.
